subject.title: [Bug]: embedded prompt-cache continuity breaks across room events and native Responses

question: Does the linked candidate preserve OpenClaw’s authorization boundary when protected tool schemas remain model-visible but unavailable calls are denied by the outer runtime wrapper?
rationale: The regression and implementation direction are well supported, but relocating enforcement from prompt filtering to a shared runtime gate needs explicit owner confirmation across all execution adapters.

options.title: Accept runtime-gated catalogue
options.body: Approve this boundary after exact-head review confirms denial before hooks and side effects across Pi, Codex, Copilot, and plugin tool paths.

options.title: Require narrower visibility
options.body: Request a different cache-stability design if protected schemas must remain hidden from unauthorized turns despite the runtime gate.

recommendation.title: Accept runtime-gated catalogue
